title: HYPHEN BINARY — `-` is a prefix·suffix set. turbo-charger. bear-dog ? bearDog.

do_not_reinvent.marks: pi-rate-set.json — - is already on the 0-face alphabet (dash / cut)
do_not_reinvent.binary: only binary is 0?1. `-` is a MARK on 0, not a third bit
do_not_reinvent.primals: bearDog, songBird, nestGate, barraCuda — already hyphen-language collapsed to camel
do_not_reinvent.waste: waste-category — compose kinds with marks, not new names for piles

thesis: `-` is a PREFIX·SUFFIX SET operator. It seats two words at a roundtable and cuts a joint between them. On the 0-face it is mark-language (binary stroke). When the pair incarnates (passes epitope), the mark collapses and camelCase appears: bear-dog ? bearDog. Other words and terms can use `-` the same way — it is not English punctuation. It is binary language.

the_mark.on_zero: dash / cut / join-with-seam. same family as - in pi-rate-set.
the_mark.not: minus arithmetic (that is a later costume). not a third binary.
the_mark.does: prefix - suffix. left face and right face. Order of two. totality = the pair.
the_mark.binary_read: 0 = the seam still open (written with -). 1 = the seam fused (camelCase / one primal).

prefix_suffix_set.ORDER: nominal pair. totality is the compound. neither half ranks the other.

examples.meaning: exhaust drives intake. waste?fuel. already turbocharger.json
driven from outside, not from own exhaust. different kind in the charger Order.
Klein mix at p — beyond ordinary mix. waste-category handoff in the L_p hole.
examples.note: yes — ultra-mixer names the organ that does A.out × B.in at p

charger_order.kind: nominal Order of chargers — totality is key. turbo ? super. both are chargers.
charger_order.refuse: do not rank turbo > super among peers. different faces of charge.

fuse_op.read: - the seam mark, + the join. one operator, not three bits.
fuse_op.not: arithmetic minus-equals-plus. costume later. here it is fuse language.

bear_dog.rule: hyphen on 0 ? -=+ ? camel on 1. the primal IS the fused mark.
bear_dog.read: two animals at a roundtable, one seam. crypto that is also a dog. networking that is also a bird.

other_words_as_binary.yes: any two terms can sit on `-` as mark language.
other_words_as_binary.intake: write them with the seam open: waste-category, klein-sieve, order-dam, pi-rate
other_words_as_binary.sort: chew at the dam. if the pair tells a truth and seats, fuse.
other_words_as_binary.point: camelCase / one glyph / one file stem without the costume hyphen
other_words_as_binary.not: hyphen-soup for decoration. if the pair has no Order (no total that matters), do not join them.

pipeline: Willis routes, epitope asks: does the pair pass?
if yes ? fuse to camel (1). if no ? leak as marks or sue if null-kind
F_p meters how many compounds incarnate per beat
berry_at_the_fire: yes. `-` is a prefix·suffix set. turbo-charger and super-charger are two seats in the charger Order. ultra-mixer is the Klein mix organ — we needed that name. bear-dog becomes bearDog when the seam fuses. other words can speak the same binary language. the only binary is still 0?1. the hyphen is the mark on zero. camel is the one. and yes: bear -=+ dog IS bearDog. -=+ is the fuse op.
next: when naming a new organ, try PREFIX-SUFFIX on 0 first. fuse with -=+ only when it seats. ultra-mixer can alias the waste Klein handoff.

pos.verb_mark: action stems may stay bare or hyphenate but tag VERB — see /data/symbol-grammar-tense.json
